completion_data.completion_summary: Implemented three literature extension convention changes: gitignored co-location of PDF/DJVU sources in specs/literature/, content-aware 4,000-line logical chunking with heading detection replacing the fixed 10-page approach, and enriched index.json schema with authors, title, year, doc_type, source_format, parent_doc, and page_range fields. Updated SKILL.md, literature-agent.md, commands/literature.md, EXTENSION.md, README.md, and literature-organization.md consistently.

memory_candidates.content: The .claude/skills/skill-literature/SKILL.md and .claude/extensions/literature/skills/skill-literature/SKILL.md are hardlinked (same inode). Similarly, .claude/agents/literature-agent.md and .claude/commands/literature.md are symlinks to their extension counterparts. Edits to extension source files automatically propagate to synced copies — no separate mirror step needed.
